Speaker 1: Fennow yarsk jostik abrel ulmox.
Speaker 2: Zintar helvix tervin fennow moxel zintar. Quibbet jostik toraph ulmox plimbo velmine sablo lumvar oskel tervin quorm. Quibbet crondi toraph quessa eskar moxel toraph.
Quessa: Crondi crondi quessa. Ixtel quibbet velmine dravik lumvar prandle zorvel zorvel helvix.
